title: Expedition hopes to find aviator Amelia Earhart's plane on remote island
caption:
A new expedition is heading to the remote Pacific to investigate a mysterious object that could be the lost plane of Amelia Earhart. Researchers are looking for clues in the shallow waters of Nikumaroro Island where she may have landed decades ago.

Source: Bbc - Expedition hopes to find aviator Amelia Earhart's plane on remote island
